profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Objective
•	To obtain a Senior Software Engineer position

Summary
•	14 years of industrial experience. Experienced with Java, Restful Webservices, Javascript, Perl, Html, UML, XML, SQL for Oracle, Clearcase, Git, Intellij, Eclipse, Unix, Windows.
•	14 years of experience with object oriented programming. Working knowledge with design patterns and UML.
•	Self-motivated, eager learner, innovative, creative, team player.

Specialties: Java, Multithreaded programming

positions.description: Implement Spring batch job to migrate transaction data from Oracle to Kafka.

positions.description:
Implement functional tests to get funding options rest web services

Fix various bugs reported by eBay during checkout proces

positions.description: Consultant to Cisco's Spark integration projects.   Rest Web Services.

positions.description: Developed Rest Web Services for Ariba's Open API project.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff I, Software Engineer
positions.description: Backend engineer for online classified ads team.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Implemented java-based internet ad extraction application.
•	Maintain, implement changes to corporate website.
•	Trained international engineering team offshore on products I supported.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Implemented integration module between Serus’s supply chain management application and Great Plains.  Retrieved data from database, generated XML using Java Web Services Developer’s Pack 2.0, and sent data through the Great Plains Webservice API.
•	Implemented various features for Serus’s supply chain management web application using Apache OJBs, JSPs, and Java.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented Enterprise JavaBeans (EJBs) called from Mozilla’s server-side Javascript interpreter.  EJBs mapped to Oracle database tables.
•	Diagnosed, debugged, and fixed performance bottlenecks in enterprise eLearning multithreaded server in C++.  Provided fix for multithread bug where server processed twice the number of transactions under Segue’s Silk. Diagnosed bottlenecks in application files written in Javascript.
•	Diagnosed server database caching performance bottleneck.  Diagnosed and designed fix whereby customer reports caching time drops from 1 hour to 1 minute.  Outstanding results recognized by Vice President of Engineering.
•	Characterized performance of multithreaded eLearning web application.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed enhancements to backend ordering system allowing for flexible integration of future payment options.  Applied factory design pattern into design.
•	Implemented enhanced guided searching, filtering, sorting capabilities for cruise searches for website.  Modified code written using EJBs, Html, JSPs, Javascript. More user-friendly enhancement resulted in less unsuccessful searches.
•	Resolved various bugs before the launch of enterprise web application including: credit card encryption bug, browser/platform compatibility problems. 
•	Integrated Cybersource payment method API into backend ordering system.  API include functionality to authorize and charge consumer’s credit card online.  Website successfully processed credit card charges.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Researched and developed module for overlaying components (buttons, text, drop down list) dynamically over banner in real time.  Innovation complimented by peers and executive team.
•	Wrote Java servlet generating Html, Javascript user interface allowing user to input XML rules for online advertising campaign.  User interface eased rule inputting for sales team saving them time from hardcoding XML rules into campaign server.
•	Wrote software test suite for adserver in Perl and Java generating JavaScript test scripts for Webload.  Test suite characterized performance of adservers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Wrote Java user interface managing routers connecting a cluster of machines.  Delivered user interface on time.
•	Clearcase administrator. Wrote Clearcase triggers in Perl and supported users.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Wrote source control tools written in Perl on top of CVS.
•	Wrote a Perl/Tk GUI for the tools.
